description: This file defines a repository interface for User entities, providing methods to find users by username and email within a Spring Data JPA context.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing User entities, extending JpaRepository to inherit CRUD operations and defining custom query methods.

methods.name: findByUsername
methods.description: Finds a User entity based on the provided username.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a User entity based on the provided email.
